description: Electricity Cost Intelligence and Solar Rebate Database - Data Sources Documentation

data_sources.usage_notes: Comprehensive utility rate database with over 3,700 U.S. utilities. Data collected and quality-controlled by Illinois State University on behalf of DOE. Supports querying by utility name, geographic location (lat/lon with radius), sector, rate code, and approval status. Free API key required.
best_practices: Register for free API key at openei.org/services/api/signup
Use version 8 API for latest features and international rates
Query by geographic location for location-specific rates
Filter by sector (Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Lighting)
Download approved rates in bulk CSV/JSON format
Cache rate data (updates monthly)
Use for comprehensive rate structure analysis
export_options: Bulk download of all approved rates

data_sources.source_name: EIA Form 861 - Annual Electric Power Industry Report
data_sources.usage_notes: Comprehensive census of all U.S. electric utilities. Annual data from 1990. Typical data release delays of 1-2 years. Available through EIA website and Electricity Data Browser interactive tool.
best_practices: Download annual data files from EIA website
Use Electricity Data Browser for interactive queries
Process normalized database tables for analysis
Combine with Form EIA-861M for monthly updates
Use for utility company identification and classification

data_sources.usage_notes: Comprehensive state-level electricity data with 2024 data (released November 2025). Includes historical data back to prior years. Interactive Electricity Data Browser with charting and mapping capabilities.
best_practices: Use Electricity Data Browser for interactive queries
Download state profiles in Excel/CSV format
Compare rates across states
Use for state-level electricity cost intelligence

data_sources.source_name: EIA Annual Average Electricity Price by State
data_sources.usage_notes: Annual average retail electricity prices by state and provider type from 1990. Based on Form EIA-861 submissions. Available through Data.gov catalog.
best_practices: Search Data.gov catalog for 'annual electricity price'
Download Excel files with average prices by state
Use for historical price trend analysis
Combine with current year data for comprehensive analysis

data_sources.source_name: DSIRE - Database of State Incentives for Renewables & Efficiency
data_sources.usage_notes: Comprehensive database of state, local, utility, and federal incentives for renewable energy and energy efficiency. Operated by NC Clean Energy Technology Center at NC State University. Searchable by zip code, state, and incentive type. API available for programmatic access.
best_practices: Search by zip code for location-specific incentives
Filter by incentive type (rebate, tax credit, grant, etc.)
Use API for programmatic access to incentive data
Track federal, state, and local incentive combinations
Use for comprehensive solar rebate intelligence

data_sources.usage_notes: U.S. Department of Energy resource for federal tax credits and rebates. Directs users to DSIRE for comprehensive state and local incentives. Provides authoritative federal incentive information.
best_practices: Use for federal tax credit information
Reference DSIRE for comprehensive incentive search
Track federal incentive changes and updates
Combine with DSIRE data for complete incentive picture

data_sources.usage_notes: Website providing electricity rates information organized by rate codes. May require web scraping for data extraction. Note: PowerOutage.us REST API is for power outage data, not rates.
best_practices: Use web scraping with respect to robots.txt
Cache scraped data to minimize requests
Validate against official sources (EIA, OpenEI)
Use for rate code reference and organization

data_sources.usage_notes: Federal open data portal with multiple electricity-related datasets. Use package_search endpoint to find relevant datasets. Includes utility company lookups, rate data, and consumption data.
best_practices: Search for 'electricity', 'utility', 'rates' keywords
Filter by relevant federal agencies (DOE, EIA)
Download datasets for comprehensive analysis
Use for additional electricity data sources

data_sources.usage_notes: Each state has a Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) that regulates utilities and approves rates. Websites vary by state. Some provide APIs, others require web scraping or manual downloads.
best_practices: Identify state PUC/PSC websites for each state
Look for tariff filing databases
Download rate schedules and tariff documents
Use for state-specific rate intelligence
Combine with federal sources for comprehensive data

data_sources.usage_notes: EPA Energy Star rebate finder for energy-efficient products including solar panels. Searchable by zip code. Provides utility and manufacturer rebates.
best_practices: Search by zip code for location-specific rebates
Filter by product type (solar panels)
Use for Energy Star certified product rebates
Combine with DSIRE for comprehensive rebate data

geographic_data.description: Geographic coordinate system for utility locations, rate areas, and solar installation sites

state_boundaries.description: State boundaries and utility service territories

notes: OpenEI Utility Rates API provides comprehensive rate structure data for 3,700+ utilities
EIA Form 861 provides annual utility census data from 1990
DSIRE is the authoritative source for solar rebates and incentives
State utility commission websites provide state-specific rate filings and tariffs
PowerOutage.us provides rate code organization and reference
Data.gov provides additional federal electricity datasets
All rate data should be validated against official sources (EIA, OpenEI)
Solar rebate data should be cross-referenced with DSIRE for completeness
Geographic data uses WGS84 (EPSG:4326) coordinate system
Rate codes are critical for organizing and categorizing electricity rates
Historical data available for rates (10+ years) and incentives (20+ years)
Target data size of 2GB includes rate structures, utility data, rebates, and geographic information
